top_signals.title: Fed's Hammack says higher rates could be needed as risks of 'inflationary mindset' forming grow
top_signals.summary: The Cleveland Fed president said that tighter monetary policy would be needed to bring down inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Albertsons Seeks More Than $9 Billion Over Busted Kroger Deal
top_signals.summary: Albertsons Cos. is demanding that Kroger Co. pay more than $9 billion for the collapse of what would have been the largest US grocery chain merger in history.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
